narration.text: Ninety-three rappers, one dot each. Higher dot, more plays per day. Start at the bottom.
narration.measuredTranscript: 93 rappers. One dot each. Higher dot. More plays per day. Start at the bottom.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: This chart holds 93 rappers, one dot each, and height means daily plays.

claims.text: There are 93 rappers in the field, one dot each.
sourceCandidates: the verified 93-artist dataset with one daily-play value each

claims.text: A higher dot means more plays per day.
sourceCandidates: the documentary's own stated axis definition

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: One verified daily-play value for each of the 93 rappers, on a fixed declared scale.
A readable statement of what height encodes.

visualEvents.description: The full field populates and reads as 93 separate marks.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: Higher dot, more plays per day
visualEvents.description: The vertical axis meaning becomes explicit.
visualEvents.matchedTranscript: Higher dot. More plays per day.

visualEvents.description: The camera resolves on the low end of the field.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not rescale between the minimum and maximum supplied values.
prohibitions.reason: The desired outcome specifies a truthful fixed scale. Per-axis min-max rescaling makes a 959x value ratio render as a 1.5x size ratio.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not treat marker size, glow, depth or camera angle as magnitude.
prohibitions.reason: Spatial rendering rules: those are not evidence of magnitude.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not present unlabelled field images as identified people.
prohibitions.reason: Image slots in several layouts are assigned from a general pool and are not identities.

successConditions: The viewer counts a dense field, not a handful of marks.
The viewer knows height means daily plays before the tour begins.
failureConditions: The field reads as fewer marks than 93.
The axis meaning is never stated.
The scale is relative rather than fixed.

groundTruth.desired: Truthful fixed-scale 3D population field with one verified dot per rapper
